desc: Parse input N, M and the M colored cells.
Initialize dictionaries/maps for `R_min`, `R_max`, `C_min`, `C_max`. Default `R_min=0, R_max=N, C_min=0, C_max=N`.
If Black `(r, c)`: update `R_min[r] = max(R_min[r], c)`, `C_min[c] = max(C_min[c], r)`.
If White `(r, c)`: update `R_max[r] = min(R_max[r], c - 1)`, `C_max[c] = min(C_max[c], r - 1)`.
Check if `R_min[r] <= R_max[r]` for all `r` in `R_min` or `R_max`. If not, print No.
Check if `C_min[c] <= C_max[c]` for all `c` in `C_min` or `C_max`. If not, print No.
Iterate through all White cells `(r, c)`:
If `R_min[r] >= c` AND `C_min[c] >= r`, print No and exit.
If all checks pass, print Yes.
